one_line_description: Time tracking and invoicing tool for teams and freelancers
auth_methods_evidence: The Composio registry lists OAuth2 as an authentication scheme for Harvest.
self_serve_evidence: Harvest offers a free trial and self-service sign-up on their website (https://www.getharvest.com/), allowing developers to obtain credentials without contacting sales.
buildability_rationale: Good API breadth with OAuth2 authentication, self-service access with free trial, and Composio support, though documentation quality needs verification.
agent_notes: The API documentation structure shows multiple endpoints for different functionalities (clients, invoices, expenses, etc.), but the actual authentication details aren't visible in the provided markdown. Composio registry confirms OAuth2 authentication and 57 tools.
